scope: forward paper target generation after one completed NYSE close
prediction_head_gate: every head must be finite, nonzero, and nonconstant

risk_intersection.new_entry: selector alpha admits the candidate only when exact-date candidate risk is NORMAL
risk_intersection.held_incremental_buy: cap at marked weight when held state is ALERT or WATCH or action freezes incremental buys
risk_intersection.released_weight: retain as CASH without reallocating to another security
risk_intersection.missing: neutral for alpha features but fail closed for a proposed new-entry risk row

execution.order_eligible_close_date: first NYSE session strictly after valuation_close_date
